scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @orbitwatch/orbital-core && npm run build -w @orbitwatch/analytic
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @orbitwatch/backend && npm run build -w @orbitwatch/frontend
scripts.build:wasm: cd packages/wasm-sgp4 && wasm-pack build --target web --release && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:arch
